# Reha Dispatch LLC (rehadispatch.com)
> Premier US Freight Orchestration, Truck Dispatching & High-RPM Logistics Partner for Owner-Operators and Fleet Owners.

## What is Reha Dispatch?
Reha Dispatch is a premier boutique US freight dispatch agency representing independent motor carriers, owner-operators, and multi-truck fleets. Reha Dispatch manages end-to-end logistics including spot-market rate negotiation, contract lane pairing, broker credit verification, broker setup packet handling, factoring submission, and aggressive recovery of detention, layover, and TONU (Truck Ordered Not Used).

## Core Guarantees & Philosophy
- **100% No Forced Dispatch**: Carriers retain complete autonomy to accept or decline any load.
- **Dedicated Senior Dispatcher**: Every carrier is paired with an experienced dispatcher (1 dispatcher per max 5 trucks).
- **Zero Accessorial Deductions**: 100% of detention pay, TONU, and layover fees are transferred directly to the carrier.
- **Transparent Fee Structure**: Flat 5% percentage per load, or dedicated weekly fleet plans. No long-term lock-in contracts.
- **Rapid 15-Minute Onboarding**: Digital paperwork processing (MC Authority, COI, W-9, NOA) via https://rehadispatch.com/onboarding.

## Equipment Types Serviced
- **Dry Van (53')**: Standard 53ft trailers, consumer packaged goods, general industrial dry freight. Focus on high-density freight corridors.
- **Reefer (53')**: Temperature-controlled cold chain, produce, pharmaceuticals, meat, dairy. Strict dwell-time management and continuous temperature tracking.
- **Flatbed & Step Deck**: Building materials, steel coils, machinery, over-dimensional freight, pipe. Full tarp fee enforcement.
- **Power Only**: Megacarrier trailer pool hook-and-drop, minimizing driver dwell time.
- **Hotshot (40')**: Expedited 40-foot gooseneck freight.

## Typical Rate Benchmarks (Spot & Dedicated Averages)
- Reefer: $3.40 – $4.40 / mile
- Dry Van: $3.10 – $3.80 / mile
- Flatbed: $3.30 – $4.20 / mile
- Power Only: $2.60 – $3.20 / mile

## Geographic Coverage
All 48 contiguous states (Continental United States) with specialized lane routing across the Midwest, Texas Triangle, Southeast, and Northeast corridors.
